meta.description: Core design tokens for GitTracker UI implementation. These are the canonical values — always read this file instead of guessing colors or fonts.

primary.usage: Lime Green — brand accent, CTA borders, active states, icon fills, label highlights

typography.heading_style: Extra-bold / Black weight for hero headings. Sentence case for H3+. Title Case for H1/H2.
typography.overline_style: UPPERCASE, letter-spaced, lime green (#BFF549), small size — used for section labels like 'PLATFORM OVERVIEW', 'IDENTITY EVOLUTION'

dark.description: Used for hero/cover pages — pure near-black with lime accent. No gradients, no drop shadows.

light.description: Used for content/interior pages — near-white background with dark ink text.

logo.symbol: Geometric G — concentric rings representing commit tracks and version branches converging at the repository core
logo.style: Minimal geometry floor — no drop shadows, no gradients, no illustrative clutter
